help:
Usage: aidd [options] [command]

Generate AI coding assistant configurations from the AIDD framework

Options:
  -V, --version                 Show version number
  --verbose                     Show detailed diagnostic output (default: false)
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  setup [options]               Set up or update the project to a correct state
                                — bootstraps the whole project (marketplace,
                                framework, tools, plugins); see `framework
                                install`, which acts on the framework alone
  framework                     Manage the framework's lifecycle on installed
                                tools: install, update, remove
  translate [options] <source>  Convert an arbitrary source into a target-native
                                plugin tree — records nothing (see `sync` for
                                the manifest-driven, tracked version)
  plugin                        Manage plugins for AI tools
  marketplace                   Manage plugin marketplaces
  auth                          Manage authentication
  sync [options] [files...]     Rewrite owned files from what is already there —
                                regenerate tracked files, driven by the manifest
                                (see `translate`, which converts a source
                                without recording anything)
  update|upgrade [options]      Update the aidd CLI itself to the latest version
  doctor [options]              Detected and equipped tools, plugins, drift, and
                                problems — across all tools or one
  clean [options]               Remove all AIDD-managed files from the project —
                                retires every part of AIDD; see `framework
                                remove`, which removes the framework only
  help [command]                display help for command

Usage: aidd auth [options] [command]

Manage authentication

Options:
  -h, --help       display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]  Authenticate with GitHub
  logout           Remove stored authentication
  status           Show authentication status

Usage: aidd auth login [options]

Authenticate with GitHub

Options:
  --gh                    Use GitHub CLI token (default: false)
  --token <value>         Personal access token
  --level <user|project>  Storage level (user or project)
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: aidd auth logout [options]

Remove stored authentication

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd auth status [options]

Show authentication status

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd clean [options]

Remove all AIDD-managed files from the project — retires every part of AIDD; see
`framework remove`, which removes the framework only

Options:
  --force     Confirm file removal (skip dry-run) (default: false)
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd doctor [options]

Detected and equipped tools, plugins, drift, and problems — across all tools or
one

Options:
  --tool <tool>    Limit to a specific AI or IDE tool
  --plugin <name>  Limit plugin checks to a specific plugin
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd framework [options] [command]

Manage the framework's lifecycle on installed tools: install, update, remove

Options:
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  install [options]  Install a tool's runtime configuration from bundled assets
                     — acts on the framework alone (see `setup`, which
                     bootstraps the whole project)
  remove [options]   Remove a tool's generated configuration files — removes the
                     framework only (see `clean`, which removes all of AIDD)
  update [options]   Re-install tool configs from bundled CLI assets, moving to
                     a new version (all installed tools if --tool is omitted;
                     see `marketplace refresh`, which re-fetches catalogs
                     instead)
  help [command]     display help for command

Usage: aidd framework install [options]

Install a tool's runtime configuration from bundled assets — acts on the
framework alone (see `setup`, which bootstraps the whole project)

Options:
  --tool <tool>  AI or IDE tool ID
  -f, --force    Overwrite already-installed tool (default: false)
  --no-plugins   Skip propagation of already-installed plugins onto the new tool
  -h, --help     display help for command

Usage: aidd framework remove [options]

Remove a tool's generated configuration files — removes the framework only (see
`clean`, which removes all of AIDD)

Options:
  --tool <tool>  AI or IDE tool ID
  -h, --help     display help for command

Usage: aidd framework update [options]

Re-install tool configs from bundled CLI assets, moving to a new version (all
installed tools if --tool is omitted; see `marketplace refresh`, which
re-fetches catalogs instead)

Options:
  --tool <tool>  Limit update to a specific AI or IDE tool
  -f, --force    Overwrite modified files without prompting (default: false)
  -h, --help     display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace [options] [command]

Manage plugin marketplaces

Options:
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  add [options] [name] [source]  Register a plugin marketplace
  list [options]                 List registered plugin marketplaces
  remove [options] <name>        Remove a registered plugin marketplace
  refresh [options] [name]       Refresh registered marketplaces — re-fetches
                                 catalogs; see `framework update`, which moves
                                 installed tools to a new version instead
  check                          Report stale marketplaces and upstream-removed
                                 plugins

Usage: aidd marketplace add [options] [name] [source]

Register a plugin marketplace

Options:
  --scope <user|project>  Registration scope (default: project) (default:
                          "project")
  --yes                   Skip the trust + cleanup prompts
  --overwrite             Replace an existing marketplace with the same name
  --token <value>         Auth token (host detected from source URL at fetch
                          time)
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace check [options]

Report stale marketplaces and upstream-removed plugins

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace list [options]

List registered plugin marketplaces

Options:
  --plugins   Also fetch and print all plugins from each marketplace catalog
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace refresh [options] [name]

Refresh registered marketplaces — re-fetches catalogs; see `framework update`,
which moves installed tools to a new version instead

Options:
  --force     Clear cache before re-fetching
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace remove [options] <name>

Remove a registered plugin marketplace

Options:
  --yes       Skip the orphan-cleanup prompt
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin [options] [command]

Manage plugins for AI tools

Options:
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  remove [options] <name>     Remove a plugin from one or all AI tools
  list [options]              List installed plugins for one or all AI tools
  install [options] [plugin]  Install a plugin (marketplace name, local path, or
                              interactive pick)
  search [options] <query>    Search registered marketplaces for plugins
  update [options] [name]     Update one or all plugins for one or all AI tools

Usage: aidd plugin install [options] [plugin]

Install a plugin (marketplace name, local path, or interactive pick)

Options:
  --from <market>         Marketplace name (when multiple match)
  --tool <toolId>         Target AI tool (default: all installed)
  --token <value>         Auth token (host detected from source URL at fetch
                          time)
  --scope <user|project>  Install scope; must match the tool's supported scope
  --yes                   Auto-resolve interactive prompts (CI mode)
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin list [options]

List installed plugins for one or all AI tools

Options:
  --tool <toolId>  Target AI tool (default: all installed)
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin remove [options] <name>

Remove a plugin from one or all AI tools

Options:
  --tool <toolId>  Target AI tool (default: all installed)
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin search [options] <query>

Search registered marketplaces for plugins

Options:
  --recommended         Show only recommended plugins
  --marketplace <name>  Limit to a single marketplace
  -h, --help            display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin update [options] [name]

Update one or all plugins for one or all AI tools

Options:
  --tool <toolId>  Target AI tool (default: all installed)
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd setup [options]

Set up or update the project to a correct state — bootstraps the whole project
(marketplace, framework, tools, plugins); see `framework install`, which acts on
the framework alone

Options:
  --source <mode>           Framework source: remote or local
  --path <dir>              Absolute path to local framework (required with
                            --source local)
  --release <tag>           Marketplace release tag to fetch (e.g., v1.2.3)
  --ai <ids>                Comma-separated AI tool IDs, or 'all' (e.g.,
                            claude,cursor or all)
  --ide <ids>               Comma-separated IDE tool IDs, or 'all' (e.g., vscode
                            or all)
  --plugins <mode>          Plugin install mode: none | all | recommended |
                            comma-separated names
  --no-default-marketplace  Skip auto-registering aidd-framework (no source
                            prompt, no plugin install)
  --yes                     Accept defaults without prompting
  -h, --help                display help for command

Usage: aidd sync [options] [files...]

Rewrite owned files from what is already there — regenerate tracked files,
driven by the manifest (see `translate`, which converts a source without
recording anything)

Arguments:
  files            Limit sync to specific tracked files

Options:
  -f, --force      Sync without prompting (default: false)
  --tool <tool>    Limit sync to a specific tool
  --plugin <name>  Limit sync to a specific plugin
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd translate [options] <source>

Convert an arbitrary source into a target-native plugin tree — records nothing
(see `sync` for the manifest-driven, tracked version)

Arguments:
  source                   Path to the source framework directory

Options:
  --to <target>            Conversion target (claude, cursor, copilot, codex,
                           opencode)
  --out <dir>              Output directory (marketplace dist or project root)
  --as <marketplace|flat>  Output layout (default: "marketplace")
  --force                  Overwrite existing files at canonical paths (--as
                           flat only)
  -h, --help               display help for command

Usage: aidd update|upgrade [options]

Update the aidd CLI itself to the latest version

Options:
  --check      Check if a newer version is available without installing
               (default: false)
  --dry-run    Preview the update without installing (default: false)
  -f, --force  Reinstall even if already up to date (default: false)
  -h, --help   display help for command
